name: Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad
summary: Operating as an investment holding company, Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad principally engages in the trade of building materials across Malaysia. Its diverse operations are structured into four key divisions: Logistics, Warehousing, Trading, and Others. The company offers comprehensive logistics solutions, encompassing various lorry transport options such as tanker, general cargo, and side curtain vehicles, in addition to specialized project logistics and direct door-to-door delivery. Furthermore, it provides warehouse rental services. Beyond these core areas, Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad also participates in the technology sector and functions as an insurance agency. The firm additionally extends its offerings to include financial, management, and e-commerce services, as well as the commerce of miscellaneous general items. Founded in 2005 and based in Klang, Malaysia, the company underwent a name change from Complete Logistic Services Berhad in July 2022.
